messages:
anya: Heads-up: prepping onboarding for `owl-vitx-7b` into the catalog. I pushed the model-config draft to the PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/462 — need quick sanity check on weights URI, tokenizer behavior, and canary plan.
kevin: Thanks. What's the weights URI you're using? last time we had S3 path issues with lifecycle rules.
sanjay: It's s3://redwood-models/vision/owl-vitx/7b/v1/weights.tar.gz per the draft. I validated checksum locally (sha256: fa3b7...).
megan: quick check: do we have cross-region replication enabled for that bucket? EU regions will need it for canaries.
anya: Not yet. I added a note in the PR to request rr replication. Can we launch canaries in us-west-2 first, then eu-west-1 after replication is confirmed?
lucas: yep. Also FYI tokenizer-bot detected a tokenization shift on a small probe: emojis + multi-byte chars add ~2 tokens vs. our standard tokenizer. See snippet below from local eval:
```
input: "Happy 🎉 to test"
old_tokens: [Happy,  , 🎉,  , to,  , test] (6)
new_tokens: [Happy,  , 🎉,  , to,  , test] (7)
```
Should we pin a tokenizer variant or include a tokenizer override in catalog metadata?
kevin: That's important. If inference code expects certain token offsets (truncation/segmenting), that +1 token could break padding logic. In catalog metadata we can add `tokenizer_override: huggingface/roberta-base-tokenizer` or a `tokenizer_version` field.
sanjay: The model was trained with a modified BPE. I can export the exact tokenizer files and include them in the weights bundle (tokenizer.json + merges + vocab). Prefer keeping the exact tokenizer with the model to avoid drift.
megan: Agree. Add ``tokenizer_installed_from: s3://redwood-models/vision/owl-vitx/7b/v1/tokenizer.zip`` to model-config and runtime will prioritize it. Need to ensure our onboarding validator accepts `tokenizer_installed_from`.
anya: On the config validation side, current validator flags unknown top-level keys. I'll update the validator to whitelist `tokenizer_installed_from` and `tokenizer_version` for this rollout. Pinging @deploy-bot to run a dry-run catalog validation.
deploy-bot: Running catalog-lint job #2987 on branch `add/owl-vitx-7b`...
deploy-bot: catalog-lint: FAILED -> 1 unknown key: `tokenizer_installed_from` in model-config.yaml: line 12.
anya: Expected. I'll send a small validator PR in 15m.
kevin: Regarding canary strategy: suggest 5% traffic in us-west-2 on dedicated pool with rollback hook after 5m if p99 latency > 200ms or error-rate > 0.5%. Also configure fallback variant `owl-vitx-7b-quant` for capacity pressure.
lucas: For pinning, make sure `catalog:models:owl-vitx-7b:pin` is set to `v1` in the deployment manifest. We should also include `compatible_variants: [owl-vitx-7b-quant, owl-vitx-6b]` so smart routing can fall back.
sanjay: I'll produce a quantized variant (int8) and push to s3://redwood-models/vision/owl-vitx/7b/v1/quant/ — will include model card notes about quality delta.
megan: Region enablement checklist: replication ✅? (pending), compliance scans ✅ (megan done), perf profile ✅ (we ran perf harness on a3 and g5), infra tickets created? (anya)
anya: infra ticket created: INF-9182, request replication + IAM read-only role for catalog-lambda.
kevin: Small ask for runtime folks: please ensure KV cache size is aligned with max-seq 1024; last time an unexpected OOM happened on rolling canaries when seq=2048. Can we enforce `max_sequence_length: 1024` in the catalog entry?
sanjay: Model supports up to 2048 but training used 1024. I'll set `max_sequence_length: 1024` in catalog to be safe.
anya: PRs: model-config PR https://git.company/repo/pulls/462 (validator follow-up will be PR 463). Canary plan doc: https://docs.internal/canaries/owl-vitx-7b.md — please comment if missing checks.
megan: I'll coordinate EU enablement once INF-9182 shows replication in the infra ticket.
kevin: Once validator PR merges, can someone trigger catalog-lint and the onboarding pipeline (stage infra) so we can run a dry canary?
sanjay: I'll queue the onboarding job and tag it `dry-canary-usw2`.
deploy-bot: Onboarding job queued: job-8812 (dry-canary-usw2).
anya: Thanks all — if no blockers I'll merge the config after validator update and we start canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
lucas: Quick follow-up: add a post-deploy smoke test that hits token boundaries (emojis, long spans) to detect tokenization mismatches early. I can add a test in the e2e suite.
kevin: Sounds good. If anything else comes up, DM me.
megan: lgtm otherwise.
anya: Closing the loop here later today with PR links and infra updates. Thanks!
